rationale: This is the final iteration, so the design written here is the one carried forward to the unseen-track race. The best measured design is iteration 10 (kp 3.4, kd 0.30, ki 0.3, base_speed 1.3, sensors at y 0.06 with x -0.03..0.03, sensor_size 0.012, last_direction), which scored 148.11, up from 132.80 at kp 3.7. Progress rose on every track as kp fell (oval 0.53 to 0.64, s-bend 0.32 to 0.33). The trend in score across the last three steps (116.27, 132.80, 148.11) is consistent. The main concerns are that oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.307 and that max_error is still 0.064 m on every track, so every run still leaves the line. I considered a further kp step to about 3.1, since the score has risen with each kp reduction. I did not choose it. It is untested, the oscillation trend is worsening, and a regression on the unseen track cannot be checked by a later race. I therefore deliver the measured best design unchanged. The Evaluator approved this exact build, so the race is a repeat check of the 148.11 result. Expected result: a score near 148, with progress and oscillation matching iteration 10. Hypotheses for the record: (1) the off-track floor near 0.064 m is set by the track and disturbance, not by gains, since it has not moved across iterations 0 to 10; (2) lower kp improves progress until oscillation becomes the limit. Measurements wanted: steering_oscillation on every track, progress, line_loss_events, max_error, rms_error and completion_time. These will show whether oscillation is the next constraint.
